title: Near-Optimal Methods for Generalized Lipschitz Convex Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.20318v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we consider a convex optimization problem, where the upper bound on the subgradient norm depends on the objective function. We establish a lower bound on the number of iterations required by any first-order method to find an approximate solution to the problem. Furthermore, we present two near-optimal algorithms that can match the lower bound up to logarithmic factors. The first algorithm is a projected GD with a carefully designed stepsize schedule which incorporates warm-up and decay phases. The second algorithm is scalar-stepsize clipped AdamW which extends the near-optimal guarantees to the stochastic setting, where only a noisy unbiased estimator of the subgradient is available.

translated_title: 广义Lipschitz凸优化的近最优方法
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们考虑了一类凸优化问题，其中次梯度范数的上界依赖于目标函数。我们建立了任何一阶方法找到该问题近似解所需的迭代次数下界。此外，我们提出了两种近最优算法，它们能够在对数因子范围内匹配该下界。第一种算法是投影梯度下降（GD），采用精心设计的步长调度方案，其中包含预热和衰减阶段。第二种算法是标量步长的裁剪AdamW，它将近最优保证扩展到了随机设定中，即仅能获得次梯度的带噪声无偏估计的情形。
tldr: 本文针对次梯度范数上界依赖于目标函数的凸优化问题建立了迭代次数下界，并提出投影GD（带预热-衰减步长调度）和标量步长裁剪AdamW两种在对数因子内达到该下界的近最优算法，后者还能处理随机次梯度估计的情形。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes an iteration lower bound for convex optimization where the subgradient norm bound depends on the objective function, and proposes two near-optimal algorithms—projected GD with a warm-up and decay stepsize schedule and scalar-stepsize clipped AdamW (which extends to the stochastic setting)—matching the bound up to logarithmic factors.
